g.text: Inside the frontier AI help raised quality; outside it, correct answers fell

text.style: fill: #1d1d1f; font: 9.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Source: Dell'Acqua et al. (2023), HBS Working Paper 24-013, 758 BCG consultants. Quality as rated by human graders ('more than 40%'). Outside: about 84% correct without AI vs. about 60–70% with AI.
